replies.author: ImNotYourTiger
replies.body:
I don't know by who. I was banned out of nowhere in the main lobby. I tried reconnecting and all it said was error. Then after 30 mins I tried connecting again and it said it said I have 48 minutes left. 

So I don't know why I was banned or who I was banned by
